title: Local Treatment of Breast Pain Based on the Daily Use of a Topical Gel
official: Evaluating the Effect of a Medical Device Based on Inositol in Improving Breast Pain
summary: The trial aims to investigate the effect of a topical application of a medical device based on inositol in recovering breast pain
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women aged between 18 and 70 years
* Women who underwent breast surgery at least 15 days prior
* Women experiencing breast pain associated with the surgical wound

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women under the age of 18
* Ongoing systemic and/or local pain therapy
* Pregnant women
